owner_and_capability: Reminder Delivery (workflows/reminderdelivery, public) owns the personal reminder notification producer (PersonalReminderNotifications), which joins its reminder batch with the notification audience; the Scheduler Runtime Worker (services/scheduler) keeps the minute tick through the port ReminderNotificationTick; the root composition (api) binds the Delivery Platform's notification service, the notification preferences' consent, the staff and admin accounts and Workforce's on-duty staff (workforce.OnDutyStaffIDs). Step 1 of #4067 (ADR 0056 point 4, ADR 0058 point 2).
affected_tables: None: code move behind ports, no database tables or DDL affected.
atomic_cutover: One PR, no policy change. services/scheduler/reminder_notifications.go keeps only the tick (feature flag gate, on-duty setting) and calls ReminderNotificationTick; the producer, its copy table, the re-fire guard and its tests move into workflows/reminderdelivery (personal_notifications.go), split into functions within the module length and complexity thresholds. Its notices (PersonalReminderNotice) and dependencies use the workflow's own vocabulary; api/personal_reminder_notifications.go maps the notices onto the Delivery Platform's notification events through the existing delivery compose vocabulary and binds AfterCommit to the Worker's tenant runtime. workforce.OnDutyStaffIDs owns the classification of working statuses. Five keys fall (519 -> 514); notification types, copy, priorities, audience, idempotency keys, consent, duty gate and after-commit marking are unchanged; the on-duty setting is now read from the tick's settings snapshot before the consent gate instead of after it.
tests: workflows/reminderdelivery: the 15 moved producer and copy-table tests (consent as gate and filter, admin and staff-less admin scopes, aggregation and per-person dedup, assigned activity classification, duty gate, skip conditions, paused dispatch, after-commit marking and rollback, tenant isolation and DST day rotation), plus TestPersonalReminderNotificationsRequireEveryDependency and a failing presence read.

modules/delivery/application/notifications: TestPersonalReminderNoticesSpeakTheEventVocabulary pins the producer's kinds against the catalogue and its priorities and scope against the event fields; modules/workforce: TestOnDutyStaffIDsMatchesTheWorkingStatuses.

scripts/backend-architecture.sh check: green with 514 legacy violations (519 before), composition surface 1743 -> 1742; golangci-lint on the affected packages reports 0 issues; scripts/test-changed.sh origin/development; scripts/backend-architecture.sh validate-ticket --all.
